title: BioIVT CMDOSU uses the shared canonical CDASH CMDOSU list
description: Points CMDOSU across BioIVT studies at the shared canon_cm_dose_unit canonical choice list (CDASH C78417). Both studies already agreed with each other (MG/MCG/G/ML/IU/OTHER) but neither matched the real CDASH case-sensitive submission values.
rationale: Dan's standing rule for BioIVT: apply CDASH standard regardless of what either study currently does or whether they already agree. Same treatment as CMROUTE and CMDOSFRQ, applied for consistency.
source: NCI EVS CDISC CDASH Controlled Terminology CMDOSU C78417; canonical-code-list-library plan step 1c

history.note: Converts case-sensitive submission values (mg not MG, ug not MCG) even though both studies already agreed with each other.
